description: This PHP source file defines the 'Filter' class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for report filtering functionality. It implements the FilterDefinition interface and provides methods for normalizing filter data and retrieving metadata, though these methods are currently minimal implementations.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Represents a filter for reports, implementing the FilterDefinition interface with methods for normalization and retrieving metadata.

methods.description: Returns an empty array, intended to normalize filter data.

methods.name: getMeta
